sources.version: CSS Fonts Module Level 4 Working Draft
sources.notes: Defines @font-face descriptors including unicode-range and font metric overrides. Working Draft; syntax may evolve.

assumptions: The source URL is already deployable and the declared format matches the actual font resource.
licensing_data_restrictions: No user content is transmitted by normal tool execution. Third-party libraries retain their upstream licenses; font/PDF licensing remains the user’s responsibility.
uncertainty: This tool validates syntax and Unicode bounds, not whether the source font actually contains every declared code point or whether a browser will download a particular subset.
